review.instruction: Verify one credible promise is bound from business authority when present and every canonical identity constraint is traceable to supplied assets or brand evidence. No invented claim or identity element is allowed.
Verify every planned element has exactly one owner: a named Grammar relationship or an explicit custom implementation boundary. The composition must not publish or silently redefine shared Grammar.

Verify every section advances the promise through a distinct visual event and every asset slot selects exactly one feasible medium: ImageGen, SVG, code-native or existing media, with an identity-preserving brief.

Verify every motion has a static reduced-motion truth, a measurable performance budget and observable audit evidence. Source ownership belongs only to interface.generate and evidence ownership only to interface.audit.

failurePolicy: Record the exact unsupported promise, identity conflict, ownership gap, weak section, ambiguous medium or motion/proof defect. Revise only the implicated contract section and reassess; never generate media or source during composition.
